latest.notes: The office can now record customer returns and supplier orders. Visits, catalog, and orders on this app stay the same

Return delivered items from an order, and choose whether paid money goes back or is saved for the next order
The order shows each returned item, its quantity, its value, and whether it went back into stock
Orders lists every return, with each item and quantity on its own line, and a return can be cancelled
Place a supplier order, then receive the goods. Accepted goods add stock and increase what you owe
Pay a supplier in cash or from the bank now. A cheque stays pending until it clears
Print a supplier order, or share it on WhatsApp
Sales by representative is net of returns, and Collections updates as soon as you pick a representative
